timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 58-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.77, creatinine 1.95-1.99, hemoglobin 13.6-13.8, platelets 264-269, sodium 141, wbc 8.7-8.8; vitals dbp 78-82, heart_rate 76-79, map 92-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 119-123, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.94-1.96, hemoglobin 13.8, platelets 266-275, sodium 141, wbc 9.1-9.2; vitals dbp 77-82, heart_rate 74-79, map 92-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 118-123, spo2 97-99, temp 37-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 58-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
